checks.check: CREATED lists the challenge with zero responses
the guest's result is compared once the server binds it
the creator sees the guest's completed response with the contract outcome
the response carries no email, user id or device hash
a signed-in recipient starts one official attempt
accepting again resumes the same run
ACCEPTED lists the attempt in progress with the creator's name and headline
the creator cannot accept their own challenge
revocation shows in CREATED and keeps the completed response (and the attempt in progress)
